mapper.insert: INSERT INTO roadmap (child_id, roadmap_type, step_data, is_active, created_at) VALUES (#{childId}, #{roadmapType}, #{stepData}, #{isActive}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT roadmap_id , child_id , roadmap_type , step_data , is_active , created_at FROM roadmap WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY roadmap_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE roadmap SET is_active = 0 WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND is_active = 1
